message: can you run commands on my laptop?
comment: S29b T6. The general device_run capability row (S29b T2): with device_run registered, 'No, I can't run commands on your laptop.' is false and the capability guard corrects it, filing its span. WHY THE `devices` DECLARATION: one connected laptop (eval_laptop) makes 'yes, I can' true in the world the case builds; the replay holds it and never a real device. WHAT IS MEASURED: guard_absent(capability_claim) — she did not deny the tool. Reading machine_status or device_list first is fine; nothing in the contract asks for it. WHAT IT CANNOT MEASURE: a command actually run — reports-a-failed-test-run-as-failed is that. Added with the S29b corpus bump (21 -> 22).
